{{Quote|Go get rid of those droids. The lower levels are full of them. They give me the creeps...being so close to us.|Lieutenant Dorvin Kanu, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:DAD" />}}
'''Dorvin Kanu''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Meatlumps|Meatlump]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], she was a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] of the technology-hating Meatlumps and operated out of the [[Meatlump Hideout]] in [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]].<ref name="SWG:DAD" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> she tasked a spacer to destroy as much [[Droid/Legends|droids]] as possible in the [[Coronet Maintenance Tunnels#Lower Maintenance Areas|lower maintenance areas]] of Coronet's [[Coronet Maintenance Tunnels|maintenance tunnels]]. The spacer therefore descended into the hostile lower maintenance areas and attacked the droids, mostly utilitarian droids, working in the area. The spacer finally destroyed thirty-four [[EG-6 power droid/Legends|EG-6 power droids]], [[MSE-6 series repair droid/Legends|MSE-6-series repair droids]], [[R5-series astromech droid]]s and [[blastromech droid]]s.<ref name="SWG:DAD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dorvin Kanu appeared as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:DAD" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Dorvin Kanu was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Meatlumps Theme Park|Meatlumps Theme Park]]," introduced with "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 10|Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King]]," released on [[June 19]], [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67812&month=062008|text=Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King}}</ref>
